values.EndLocation: H.F. Lee Energy Complex, near Goldsboro, Wayne County

researcher_notes: Piedmont Natural Gas signed an agreement in October 2009 with Progress Energy Carolinas to build about 38 miles of 20-inch pipe and compression to serve the new Wayne County plant, approved by the state utilities commission in May 2010 (Piedmont annual report for fiscal 2011; Pipeline and Gas Journal December 2009). A WRAL news story from the construction period says the 38-mile line runs from a facility in Clayton to the new plant near Goldsboro. The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), row 718, lists it as a completed new intrastate pipeline, 38 miles, 20 inch, in service June 2012. Piedmont's investor update gave a June 1, 2012 in-service target; completion rests on the EIA entry only. No existing roster row for Piedmont in North Carolina, so this is not a match to an existing row. Length is above the 25 km threshold. Parent was left blank because no verified source was opened for it. Capacity not found. No route found; no state GIS checked. Owner style: no legal form found in registry lookup, recorded as the sources spell it.
